name: What are some popular spa-inspired features to consider for a luxury bathroom design?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular spa-inspired features to consider for a luxury bathroom design?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a luxury, spa-inspired bathroom design, popular features include spacious walk-in showers with rainfall showerheads and body jets, freestanding soaking tubs, heated flooring, and advanced lighting systems. Custom vanities with ample storage and integrated smart technology also enhance the experience. Our expertise allows us to integrate these elements into a cohesive design that transforms your everyday bath into a personal sanctuary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular spa features include walk-in showers with rainfall heads, freestanding tubs, heated flooring, and custom vanities.
